updateTime.description: Date and time when this consolidated unavailability document was last updated by the consolidation engine

key.description: Document identifier computed as an MD5 hash of mission, subsystem and start_time

mission.description: Mission identifier derived from the satellite unit (e.g. S1, S2)

satellite_unit.description: Satellite unit affected by the unavailability (e.g. S1A)

file_name.description: Name of the source unavailability file the record was ingested from

unavailability_reference.description: Reference identifier of the unavailability declaration

unavailability_type.description: Type of unavailability as declared in the source file

subsystem.description: Satellite subsystem concerned by the unavailability

start_time.description: Start date and time of the unavailability period

start_orbit.description: Orbit number at the start of the unavailability, with leading zeros stripped

start_anx_offset.description: Offset from the ascending node crossing at the start of the unavailability

end_time.description: End date and time of the unavailability period, empty while the unavailability is still ongoing

end_orbit.description: Orbit number at the end of the unavailability, with leading zeros stripped

end_anx_offset.description: Offset from the ascending node crossing at the end of the unavailability

type.description: Category of the unavailability record as declared in the source file

comment.description: Free-text comment associated with the unavailability

raw_data_ingestion_time.description: Ingestion time of the source raw unavailability data, used to arbitrate between concurrent updates

unavailability_duration.description: Duration of the unavailability period in microseconds, computed from start_time and end_time

real_causal_anomaly.description: Set to PDHT when an S1 OCP or SAR unavailability shares its file with a PDHT subsystem entry, indicating the real causal anomaly
